verdict.rationale: Amazon IVS documents official Player and Broadcast SDKs for mobile and web, and Broadcast SDKs for Android and iOS that let real-time users act as hosts or viewers, so platform coverage is evidenced. Nothing shows that these SDKs share one session/track model or that a single backend serves all platforms. missing for 10: evidence of a unified session and track model across web/iOS/Android, explicit web real-time SDK documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, official client SDKs cover web, iOS, and Android with the same session and track model, so one backend serves every platform

citations.quote: Integrate into interactive apps with chat APIs, and Player and Broadcast SDKs for mobile and web.
By integrating the Amazon IVS broadcast SDKs for Android and iOS, your users can engage as hosts or viewers
